faq.q: Is October 2038 a good time to rent a boat in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes. October is the shoulder season: warm sea (around 20°C), air temperatures of 22–26°C, and fewer boats on the water. You'll enjoy calmer conditions and more space, especially at anchorages like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. Just bring a light jacket for the evening breeze.

faq.q: What is the sea temperature in Marbella in October 2038?
faq.a: The Mediterranean retains summer warmth well into October. Expect sea temperatures around 20°C – comfortable for swimming if you're used to it, and perfect for water sports like paddleboarding or jet skiing (included free on the Mangusta 80).

faq.q: How much wind can I expect in October 2038?
faq.a: October typically has light to moderate winds, 5–15 knots, with occasional Levante or Poniente breezes. Your skipper will choose the best route – often west towards Estepona or east towards Cabopino – to ensure a smooth ride.

faq.q: Which boats are best for October weather?
faq.a: For a group of up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (24m) or Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) offer sheltered flybridges and spacious decks. If you're a smaller group, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) is a great value at €749 for 2 hours.

faq.q: What should I pack for an October boat trip?
faq.a: Pack swimwear, a towel, sunscreen (SPF 30+), a light jumper or windbreaker, and non-slip shoes. Even if you don't swim, the sea breeze can feel cool at speed. Sunglasses and a hat are essential – the sun is still strong in October.

faq.q: Can I swim in the sea in October in Marbella?
faq.a: Yes, but it's brisk. Sea temperature around 20°C means many locals still swim, especially on sunny days. If you're sensitive to cold, a short wetsuit or just a quick dip is fine. The water is clear and calm, ideal for snorkelling near Cabopino.

faq.q: What are the typical October departure times?
faq.a: Sunrise is around 8:30am, sunset around 7:30pm. Most charters start at 10am or 12pm for a 4-hour trip, or 11am for an 8-hour day. Your skipper will adjust the itinerary to maximise sunshine and avoid any afternoon breezes.

faq.q: How far in advance should I book for October 2038?
faq.a: October is less busy than July or August, but weekends and half-term weeks fill up. Book 2–3 weeks ahead to secure your preferred boat and time. For the Mangusta 80, which includes a free jet ski, early booking is recommended.

data.body_html:
October 2038 is one of the best-kept secrets for a Marbella boat rental. The summer crowds have gone, the sea has soaked up months of sunshine and sits at a pleasant 20°C, and the air hovers between 22°C and 26°C. You get the glamour of Puerto Banús without the gridlock, and the anchorages are blissfully quiet. Whether you're after a relaxed family day or a lively group charter, the shoulder season delivers.

October Weather in Marbella: The Numbers

October marks the transition from summer to autumn, but the Mediterranean holds onto its warmth. Average high temperatures reach 26°C, with lows around 16°C after dark. You'll enjoy around 7 hours of daily sunshine, and rain is rare – typically just 2-3 days in the whole month. Sea breezes are light to moderate (5-15 knots), making for smooth cruising along the coast.

Air temperature (day)22–26°C
Sea temperature~20°C
Sunshine hours~7h/day
Rain days2–3
Wind speed5–15 knots

Why Choose the Shoulder Season for Your Charter

October offers the perfect balance: warm enough to swim and sunbathe, but cool enough for active exploration. You'll avoid the peak-season queues at Puerto Banús and have more choice of berths at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. Plus, many skippers will extend your route west towards Estepona or east to Cabopino, where the water is glassy and the coastline is stunning.

Best Boats for October Conditions

For groups up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (24m) is a standout – it comes with a free jet ski, perfect for making the most of the calm sea. From €4,719 for a 4-hour charter, it's a premium option. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) offers a sheltered flybridge for those cooler breezes, while the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) at €749 for 2 hours is ideal for a smaller group wanting a taste of luxury. All our boats depart from Puerto Banús.

What's Included in Every Charter

We keep it simple – no hidden extras. Every rental includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You just bring your swimsuit and sunglasses. For the Mangusta 80, the jet ski is thrown in free.

October Itinerary Ideas

  • West to Estepona: 1.5h cruise, anchor at Playa del Cristo, lunch at a chiringuito.
  • East to Cabopino: 1h from Banús, calm coves and clear water for snorkelling.
  • Golden Mile sunset: Late afternoon departure, watch the sun dip behind La Concha.

What to Pack for an October Boat Trip

Pack light but smart: swimwear, a towel, sunscreen (SPF 30+), a light jumper or windbreaker, and non-slip shoes. The sea breeze can feel cool when the boat is moving, so a layer is essential. A hat and sunglasses are non-negotiable – the UV index is still moderate to high in October.

Booking Tips for October 2038

October is less frantic than summer, but weekends and school half-terms fill up fast. Book 2–3 weeks ahead to secure your preferred vessel. For the Mangusta 80, early booking is especially recommended due to its popularity. You can check availability directly on our [charter hub](/), or message us on WhatsApp for a tailored quote.
